That seller went by SDCPs on the forums. I have bought seeds from him off ebay and they are what he sells them as but im confused as to why he'd use Mikes pics too. He had some pretty good pics up last year that, i assumed, were his own.


Why do eBay merchants use photos they find on the web to promote their sales? Because they can, and because that kind of thinking is part of the eBay mentality. I have to chase down offenders every year, often several times a year. The offenders are often belligerent, confrontational and come with a healthy sense of entitlement to boot. When they do this, the odds are very, very low that anyone will catch them doing it, and if they do get caught, the consequences are minor or nonexistent. There is very little disincentive to steal photos for this kind of usage.
